notes: Company background: developer tools ISV building an integrated IDE platform (VSCode + Web IDE) with embedded copilot for customers; security-sensitive verticals (finance + healthcare plugins).

Primary ask: fully air-gapped on-prem code assistant that integrates into their plugin update flow; cannot allow outbound connections from runtime (control plane may be reachable from corporate admin network but runtime must be isolated).

Workload profile: interactive code completion + contextual chat inside IDE, high-quality codegen (tests + refactor suggestions), average prompt length small (~200 tokens), tail cases up to 2k tokens for PR diff context.

Latency/throughput targets: streaming completions with 1st-token latency target <150ms for local developer sessions, sustained throughput target ~40 concurrent dev sessions per cluster with graceful degradation.

Model preferences: prefer pinned model family 'codegen-v2' quantized to 4-bit; want deterministic rollouts and ability to pin per-team model version. Fallback rules: 6B variant when 14B saturates, and a smaller distilled assistant for low-cost queries.

Hardware sizing request: Redwood suggested 4 x H100-80GB or 8 x A100-80GB with NVLink for target concurrency. Customer asked for an alternative cheaper BOM: 6x A40/RTX4xx for dev-only POC. Concern about NVSwitch topology and PCIe lanes on their on-prem racks.

Packaging / updates: require signed offline update artifacts (they call them '.airpack') delivered via checked USB + SHA256 + Redwood-signed attestations. No automatic phone-home; update orchestration must run from an admin bastion with strict RBAC.

Security notes: SSO via SAML required for admin console, KMS/HSM integration mandatory for customer keys, full audit logging retained 2 years, retention controls configurable per workspace. Quoted: 'We cannot allow model telemetry to leave the premises - full telemetry scrubbed or opt-in only.'
POC scope: 1-week on-prem install (staging), 4-week evaluation with sample VSCode plugin + integration tests, developer UX measurement (latency, first-draft quality) and cost/throughput telemetry.

Quotes / paraphrases: Customer security lead - 'no outbound on runtime; update bundles only via secure transfer and attestation.' AE notes - 'very procurement-heavy; slide deck + SOC2 addendum needed for legal.'

use_case_summary: Deploy a locally-hosted IDE copilot for enterprise customers where runtime cannot phone home. Focus on low-latency streaming completions, model-version pinning for deterministic behavior, and secure offline updates for model bundles.
evaluation_criteria: Security: no outbound runtime telemetry by default; signed offline updates; KMS integration
Performance: sustained <150ms first-byte for streaming completions under expected concurrency
Operational: clear BOM and install runbook; documented offline update process
Cost: predictable unit cost per dev seat when pinned to 14B quantized model
